target: AArch64 native ZealC in UTM-bundled QEMU with HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-apps-current-latest-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game

checks.GrModels: Man and Ball forms and mesh paths compile and pass the existing mesh/render runtime probes.
checks.KeepAway: Gameplay, HUD, mouse/Space input, 186-second full-game run with 18 repeated input cycles, active scanout, Escape recovery, Animate-task cleanup, and zstatus failed=0 passed.
checks.Titanium: Existing compile and sprite/runtime checks passed.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-budget-current-latest-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-budget-program
checks: Calendar, UTC clock and scanner setup
File/Edit/View shortcuts, menu hover and continued presentation
Budget entry creation, editing, cancellation, abort and save/reopen

scope_note: Automated checks using UTM's bundled QEMU profile, not visible UTM window acceptance. They do not resolve the earlier user-reported live UTM Budget/KeepAway freezes or confirm visible GrModels output.
